about: Commands no agent may run, whatever its role or its instructions say. Written in a neutral shape: translate each pattern into your coding agent's own permission format. A pattern denies any command that begins with it; a pattern written as a description in angle brackets denies any command that does what it describes. <app: ...> stands for the portal's own command-line entry point, with the action it would carry out described in plain words after the colon. <cluster> stands for the cluster's command-line tool, and a word in angle brackets after it stands for whichever of its commands does that.
